name: notifications-contacts
title: Notification Contacts
description: Host-protected notification contacts and consent history using KrakStack tables, search, filters, sorting and pagination.
docs: Mount NotificationContacts only behind the host admin guard. Use @krak-stack/notifications/admin for contacts and consent, and pass table state, onStateChange and server pagination with authoritative totals. Creating a contact does not subscribe it. Withdrawal remains explicit and audited. Package export: @krak-stack/registry/notifications/contacts. See src/agent-examples/send/console.tsx for integration.
